summary: TOWER_URL_BASE is set from the incoming request and stored in the database (for example when a license is posted via IP); reset it in Settings > System by editing Base URL of the service.
questions: Notifications link to an IP address instead of DNS name
Where does controller get its base URL?

answer_card.title: Fix the URL in notifications
answer_card.answer_md: Controller stores `TOWER_URL_BASE` from the request that first set it (for example posting a license via the host's IP). To change it: **Settings > System > Edit**, set *Base URL of the service* to the DNS name you want, and save.
